heroHeadline: Somalia Piracy Crisis Day 37/36/30: 44 Hostages; Adan Yabal Day 43; SNA Gedo Deployment Sparks Jubbaland Crisis; Opposition Countdown Day 17
heroSubtitle: All 44 hostages across three vessels (Honour 25, Sward, MT Eureka) remained captive on June 1, entering Day 37/36/30 with no ransom paid and no rescue mechanism — EU NAVFOR Atalanta and CTF-151 continue to be diverted from Gulf of Aden counter-piracy by Iran War operations, and Egypt's May 25 formal demand on Somalia to help free MT Eureka's eight Egyptian crew remains unmet. Al-Shabaab held Adan Yabal in Hiiraan Region for Day 43 — the longest uncontested insurgent occupation of a Hiiraan town since the 2022 SNA/Macawisley offensive — with no SNA counter-offensive despite President Mohamud's April 19 emergency order. The deployment of 700+ Turkish-trained SNA troops into Gedo Region drew protests from Jubbaland, which following its May 31 withdrawal from Somalia's federal compact now treats federal deployments as foreign military incursions. The opposition Somali Future Council countdown reached Day 17 — 13 days remain before Puntland's threatened parallel transitional authority. Galmudug's first electoral event (local/parliamentary council elections) is scheduled for June 20. AFRICOM airstrike count frozen at 63+ since May 7; WFP July 2026 operational shutdown warning active; Burhakaba (Bay Region) at IPC Phase 5 famine risk.
